post.description: Creates a donation. Authentication is OPTIONAL: send a Bearer token to have the gift attributed to your account, or none to donate as a guest (include `donor` contact details in that case). Omit `campaignId` for an unrestricted general-fund gift. The donation is always created `pending`, and for an online gateway (e.g. `chapa`) a checkout session is opened and returned under `checkout` — redirect the donor to `checkout.checkoutUrl`. The payment-gateway webhook then settles the gift to `completed`, at which point it counts toward campaign/project totals. High-value gifts (≥ 500,000 in the smallest unit, i.e. 5,000 ETB) are charged the same way, but the webhook parks them in `manual_review` instead of settling: the funds are captured while an admin decides, and only an approval credits the totals.

post.description:
Computes the caller's achievement for the requested `type` and issues a certificate — provided they meet the criteria (at least the bronze threshold: 1,000 in whole currency units raised, or 10 volunteered hours). The recipient is always the caller; there is no `userId` in the body.

**Idempotent**: if your current certificate of this type already froze exactly these numbers, that same certificate is returned and nothing new is created. Once the numbers move, a new `version` is issued and the previous one is kept (marked `supersededAt`) so links you already shared keep working unchanged.

Optional `campaignIds` / `from` / `to` narrow which campaigns and period are counted. New certificates are private (`isPublic: false`) — share one with `PATCH /certificates/:id/visibility`.

get.description: Resolves the certificate behind a share code (e.g. `DOW-FR-9F2A7C41B0`). Readable by anyone once its owner has set `isPublic`; while it is private only the owner can open it (send a Bearer token). A private certificate is reported as **404** to anyone else, so a code cannot be probed for existence. Public reads omit the owner-only fields (`recipient.id`, `isPublic`).

patch.description: Same action as `PATCH /donations/:id/review`, exposed on the admin surface. High-value gifts reach review already PAID: `approve: true` settles the donation to `completed` and credits the campaign/project totals; `approve: false` sends it to `refunded`. A gift held before any charge landed releases to `pending` (approved) or `failed` (rejected). `note` records the rationale.

200.description: The donation, now `completed`/`refunded` (paid gift approved/rejected) or `pending`/`failed` (unpaid gift released/rejected).

post.description: Settlement callback posted by Chapa — NOT for frontend use. Authenticated by the `x-chapa-signature` HMAC-SHA256 header (verified over the raw body using the dashboard webhook secret hash). The transaction is then re-verified against the Chapa API before the donation is settled. Idempotent on the transaction reference.

401.description: Missing or invalid webhook signature.

post.description: Settlement callback posted by Zeffy on `payment.completed` — NOT for frontend use. Zeffy publishes no webhook signing scheme, so the caller is authenticated by the shared secret in the callback URL (`/payments/webhook/zeffy/<secret>`, constant-time compared) and the payment is then re-fetched from the Zeffy API (`GET /api/v1/payments/:id`) — that response is authoritative, never the posted body. The verified payment is correlated to a pending `zeffy` donation by amount, currency, donor email and time, because Zeffy accepts no merchant reference to echo back. Idempotent: only `pending` donations are eligible, so a redelivery settles nothing twice.

info.title: Drop of Water — Backend API
info.description:
REST API for the Drop of Water (DoW) crowdfunding platform: water-
infrastructure **projects**, fundraising **campaigns**, **donations**,
**impact updates**, **users**, an **admin** oversight surface, and push
**notifications**.

### Authentication
Most routes require a **Firebase ID token** sent as a Bearer token:
`Authorization: Bearer <firebaseIdToken>`. Click **Authorize** and paste
the raw token (no `Bearer` prefix). Routes tagged _Public_ need no token;
the payment webhook authenticates by gateway signature instead.

### Conventions
- All monetary amounts are integers in the **smallest currency unit**
  (e.g. cents / Ethiopian santim). Default currency is `ETB`.
- List endpoints are paginated via `?page=` (1-based) and `?limit=`
  (default 10, max 100) and return a `{ data, meta }` envelope.
- Resource ids are Mongo ObjectId strings (24 hex chars).
- Timestamps are ISO 8601 strings.
